name: STARTING OVER!
source:
Tsuna is forced to undertake an extensive 7-day long mafia committee membership exam. With uneasy heart he goes to school and tries his best while facing different kinds of challenges there with the help of baby tutor named Reborn.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
纲被迫参加为期七天的黑手党委员会成员资格考试。他忐忑不安地来到学校，在名叫里包恩的婴儿家庭教师帮助下，努力面对那里形形色色的挑战。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
